app_store.name: Trova TV: Cinema & Series Hub
app_store.subtitle: Where to Watch, Awards & 4K
app_store.promotional_text: Explore 87 global film and television award ceremonies, 470+ film franchises, multi-critic ratings, and 10-foot smart TV discovery.
app_store.description:
Trova TV turns your living-room television into a unified cinema programme and discovery studio.

Built for the 10-foot D-pad experience, Trova TV brings together official regional streaming availability, verified multi-critic ratings (IMDb, Rotten Tomatoes, Metacritic), 87 global film and television award ceremonies, 470+ movie franchises, and instant landscape playback with automatic English subtitles.

Key Features:
- Widescreen 16:9 spotlight billboard with zero intrusive auto-play audio
- Multi-facet Discover Studio: filter by genre, release decade, language, and rating
- 87 Global Film and Television Honors including Academy Awards, Cannes, BAFTA, and Emmy winners
- Complete TV Season and Episode guide with air dates and runtime
- Local-first Watchlist and custom collections with zero account lock-in
app_store.whats_new: New 10-foot Android TV interface with D-pad navigation, 87 global award ceremonies, and dual-ABI playback engine.

google_play.full_description:
Trova TV turns your Android TV or Google TV into a unified cinema programme and discovery studio.

Built for the 10-foot remote control experience, Trova TV unites regional streaming availability, verified multi-critic ratings, 87 global film and television award ceremonies, 470+ movie franchises, and instant landscape playback with automatic English subtitles.

100% local-first with zero ads and no subscription wall.
